name: nation-of-elites
description: A complete 74-agent AI workforce organized like a real IT company, aligned with Claude Opus 4.8 (orchestration) and Claude Sonnet 5 (default workhorse — 1M context, near-Opus quality; Haiku not used). 12 divisions including executive leadership, strategic planning, engineering, QA, SecOps, AI/ML, mobile, construction AI, content & localization, and business development.
